brief: Describe inspection of candidate scores and traceable typed-decision records for an international research audience, without implying correctness guarantees.

candidates.name: LogitTrail
candidates.assessment: Preferred: candidate scoring and evidence traceability; no exact software name found in focused web and GitHub name searches.

candidates.name: LogitView
candidates.assessment: Alternative: readable but suggests visualization more narrowly; no GitHub name match returned.

candidates.name: ChoiceTrace
candidates.assessment: Rejected: existing AI decision/reflection app uses this exact name.

limitations: Focused name-collision screening only; not trademark clearance, exhaustive worldwide search, domain/handle reservation, company registration, or a native-speaker panel. No domain purchase or company rename.
compatibility_decision: Keep repository/Pages URL mini-jev, history, API identifiers and archive member paths; update current display branding and artifacts.
